Introduction | 01

Color blindness | Color | blindness | is | a | special | condition | where | some | people | see | colors | differently | than | most | people | do | . | For | example, | they | may | not | be | able | to | tell | red | from | green | . | However, | there | are | ways | for | people | with | color | blindness | to | recognize | and | distinguish | colors, | such | as | using | special | glasses | or | software | programs | . | Specialized | nerve | cells | (rods | and | cones) | help | you | see | . | Cones | are | responsible | for | your | color | vision | . | If | you | have | color | blindness, | some | of | your | cones | are | missing | or | don't | work | properly | .
New Knowledge | 02

Red color blindness | Also | known | as | the | first | type | of | color | blindness, | these | people | cannot | distinguish | between | red, | purple, | blue, | purple | - | red, | and | dark | green | . | They | will | see | green | as | yellow, | purple | as | blue, | and | green | and | blue | as | white | . | Full | - | color vision | Red color blindness

Green color blindness | This | is | the | second | type | of | color | blindness | . | People | with | this | condition | see | green | as | gray | and | cannot | distinguish | between | light | green | and | dark | red, | purple | and | gray, | and | purple | and | cyan | . | Full | - | color vision | Green color blindness

Color blindness corrective glasses | Color | blindness | corrective | glasses | are | a | type | of | glasses | used | to | correct | color | blindness | . | They | are | an | effective | way | to | correct | color | blindness | and | are | suitable | for | people | who | suffer | from | both | color | blindness | and | myopia | . | In | addition, | color | blindness | corrective | glasses | are | divided | into | contact | lens | type | and | ordinary | wide | frame | type | .

Coding block  | - | color recognition learning | This | coding | block | determines | whether | the | image | has | a | corresponding | ID | color | . | When | the | program | is | running, | you | need | to | operate | the | AI | ௙௙PRGXOH | dial | to | shoot | and | learn | the | color | . | Description | : | Return | value | : | 1 | or | 0 | , | Boolean | type | .

Design and assembly | According | to | the | building | manual, | build | a | colorblind | assistant | robot | . | We | need | a | controller | to | control | the | motor | rotation | and | call | the | AI | ௙௙YLVLRQ | module | . | Connect | the | AI | ௙௙YLVLRQ | module | to | the | P | 8 | port | of | the | controller, | and | connect | the | motor | to | the | M | 1 | ports | .
